name: Scarred Soul
source: The Sacred Academy of Feäadar stands as the most prestigious institution in all the Empire. Within its ancient halls, scholars master not only the sciences, but also the intricate art of spellcraft. Klins, the son of the Academy’s director, bears a burden unlike any other - he cannot wield magic. Whispers of nepotism follow him through the corridors. Struggling onward, he reaches his final year, determined to prove himself worthy of his father’s expectations and his own ambitions. Fate takes an unexpected turn when Klins uncovers a hidden passage - one that may change his destiny, for better or for worse.
translation: 费阿达尔神圣学院是整个帝国最负盛名的机构。在其古老的大厅里，学者们不仅掌握科学，还掌握复杂的法术艺术。克林斯是学院院长的儿子，他背负着与其他人不同的负担——他无法使用魔法。走廊里传来裙带关系的低语声。他奋力前行，进入了人生的最后一年，决心证明自己不辜负父亲的期望和自己的抱负。当克林斯发现了一条隐藏的通道时，命运发生了意想不到的转变——这条通道可能会改变他的命运，无论是好是坏。
